site.title: Spatial Omics Radar
site.subtitle: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

entries.name: NNclinSSOAP
entries.title: GxP-Ready Single-Cell RNA-seq and Spatial Transcriptomics End-to-End Pipeline for Clinical Research
entries.one_liner: Modular GxP-ready pipeline converting scRNA-seq and Xenium data into annotated, reproducible tissue maps.

entries.name: SpatialGEO
entries.title: Geometric-aware deep learning for deciphering tissue structure from spatially resolved transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Geometric-aware deep learning framework producing embeddings from expression and spatial coordinates for tissue structure dissection.

entries.name: AESTETIK
entries.title: Representation learning for multi-modal spatially resolved transcriptomics data
entries.one_liner: Convolutional model jointly integrating spatial, transcriptomic and morphology data for spot clustering.

entries.name: CONCISE
entries.title: Spatial co-expression and cell-cell communication inference from spatially resolved transcriptomics with CONCISE
entries.one_liner: Statistical method jointly modeling spatial autocorrelation and count variation for co-expression and ligand-receptor inference.

entries.name: in situ graphene-seq
entries.title: In situ graphene-seq: spatial transcriptomics and chronic electrophysiological characterization of tissue microenvironments
entries.one_liner: Platform integrating stretchable graphene electrodes for chronic electrophysiology with imaging-based in situ transcriptomics.

entries.name: spammR
entries.title: spammR: an R package designed for analysis and integration of spatial multi-omic measurements
entries.one_liner: R package for end-to-end analysis and integration of mass-spectrometry-based spatial multi-omics data.

entries.name: SpaVGMC
entries.title: SpaVGMC: A Unified Representation Learning Framework via Structural and Semantic Alignment in Spatial Transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Variational graph representation-learning framework aligning structure and semantics for spatial domain identification.
entries.venue: Journal of chemical information and modeling

entries.name: AdPrST
entries.title: AdPrST:An Adversarial Graph Deep Learning Pre-clustering Framework for Deciphering Spatiotemporal Structures in Spatially Resolved Transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Adversarial graph pre-clustering framework inferring spatial domains and developmental trajectories from SRT data.
entries.venue: IEEE transactions on computational biology and bioinformatics

entries.name: HESTIA
entries.title: HESTIA: Scalable Multimodal Integration of Histology and High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics for Robust Spatial Domain Identification
entries.one_liner: Memory-efficient multimodal algorithm identifying spatial domains from histology plus high-resolution spatial transcriptomics.

entries.name: DEGAS
entries.title: Identification of high-risk cells in single-cell spatially resolved transcriptomics data using Diagnostic Evidence GAuge of Single-cells with spatial smoothing
entries.one_liner: Domain-adaptation neural model with new spatial smoothing to flag high-risk cells in spatial transcriptomics.

entries.name: GCAST
entries.title: Identifying batch-integrated domains from spatial transcriptomics via graph autoencoder with contrastive learning based on cross-modality and data augmentation
entries.one_liner: Graph contrastive autoencoder integrating histology and expression to identify batch-corrected tissue domains.

entries.name: TENGU
entries.title: A transcriptomic-driven segmentation and cell simulation framework for high-resolution spatial transcriptomics and cell-cell communication
entries.one_liner: Software that segments cells from transcript-signal density and simulates boundaries for high-resolution spatial data.

entries.name: Mievformer
entries.title: Probabilistic coupling of cellular and microenvironmental heterogeneity by masked self-supervised learning
entries.one_liner: Transformer-based self-supervised model learning microenvironment embeddings from neighboring cell states.

entries.name: SpatialQuery
entries.title: SpatialQuery: scalable discovery and molecular characterization of multicellular motifs from spatial omics data
entries.one_liner: Identifies recurrent multicellular spatial motifs and characterizes their molecular programs via differential/covariation analysis.

entries.name: Benchmarking tools for deciphering cellular crosstalk in spatially-resolved transcriptomics
entries.title: Benchmarking tools for deciphering cellular crosstalk in spatially-resolved transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Benchmarks nine cell-cell interaction inference tools across simulated and real spatial transcriptomics datasets.

entries.name: Img2Gene
entries.title: Img2Gene: Debiased Spatially Resolved Transcriptomics with Biological Context from Pathology Images

entries.venue: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics

entries.name: STDrug
entries.title: STDrug enables spatially informed personalized drug repurposing from spatial transcriptomics

entries.name: TOAST
entries.title: Topography-aware optimal transport for alignment of spatial omics data

entries.name: TUSCAN
entries.title: TUSCAN: Tumor segmentation and classification analysis in spatial transcriptomics

entries.name: EnsAgent
entries.title: EnsAgent: a tool-ensemble multiple Agent system for robust annotation in spatial transcriptomics

entries.title: MORPHE: Bridging Image Generation and Spatial Omics for Tissue Synthesis

entries.name: Castl
entries.title: Castl: robust identification of spatially variable genes in spatial transcriptomics via an ensemble-based framework

entries.name: AICellType
entries.title: AICellType: a large language model-based platform for accurate cell type annotation

entries.name: mosna
entries.title: mosna Reveals Different Types of Cellular Interactions Predictive of Response to Immunotherapies and Survival in Cancer

entries.name: ovrlpy
entries.title: Identifying 3D signal overlaps in spatial transcriptomics data with ovrlpy

entries.name: stDyer-image
entries.title: stDyer-image improves clustering analysis of spatially resolved transcriptomics and proteomics with morphological images

entries.name: NNclinSSOAP
entries.title: GxP Single-cell RNA-seq and Spatial Transcriptomics end-to-end pipeline for clinical research
entries.one_liner: Nextflow-based clinical pipeline processing scRNA-seq and Xenium spatial transcriptomics into annotated tissue maps.

entries.name: MAGPIE
entries.title: Spatially resolved integrative analysis of transcriptomic and metabolomic changes in tissue injury studies

entries.name: SpotSweeper-py
entries.title: Spotsweeper-py: spatially-aware quality control metrics for spatial omics data in the Python ecosystem
entries.one_liner: Computes neighborhood-aware z-scores for spatial QC metrics in Python, porting SpotSweeper from R.

entries.name: spoon
entries.title: Addressing the mean-variance relationship in spatially resolved transcriptomics data with spoon

entries.name: LARIS
entries.title: LARIS enables accurate and efficient ligand and receptor interaction analysis in spatial transcriptomics

entries.name: CadaST
entries.title: Probabilistic-graph-based spatial context-aware framework for interpretable spatial omics denoising and augmentation

entries.name: Castl
entries.title: Castl: Robust Identification of Spatially Variable Genes in Spatial Transcriptomics via an Ensemble-based Framework
entries.one_liner: Ensemble framework that statistically aggregates multiple spatially variable gene detection methods to control false discovery.

entries.name: Integrative Spatial Omics for Systems-Level Mapping of Pathological Niches

entries.one_liner: Empirical Bayes framework removing mean-variance bias when ranking spatially variable genes.
